message.content: In one of the conversations, JakeWatson mentions that proper warm-up and stretching are crucial before any game. While the detailed stretches he recommends are not explicitly stated, he implies the importance of these activities. Specifically, he suggests that staying hydrated and wearing the right footwear can also make a significant difference to avoid slips or sprains. He further emphasizes the benefits of strength training, which helps build the muscles around your joints, improves overall stability and endurance on the field, and provides an extra boost during runs. Although he does not provide a list of specific stretches, he encourages LiHua to start with bodyweight exercises like squats, lunges, and planks, which are simple yet effective for building core and leg strength. Additionally, he suggests including balance exercises such as single-leg stands to enhance performance and reduce injury risks.
